models.name: message_detail_type
models.query: SELECT message_type, version, description, schema_definition, updated_date FROM message_detail_type_raw

models.name: user_profile
models.query: SELECT user_id, user_name, email, phone, country, region, signup_date, last_login_date FROM user_profile_raw

models.name: device_reference
models.query: SELECT device_code, device_type, device_category, manufacturer, is_supported FROM device_reference_raw WHERE is_supported = true

models.name: event_tracker
models.query: SELECT e.event_id, e.session_id, e.user_id, e.event_type, e.event_name, e.event_timestamp, e.payload, e.source_system, e.event_version FROM events_raw e INNER JOIN message_detail_type m ON substring_index(e.event_type, '.', 1) = m.msg_type AND substring_index(e.event_type, '.', -1) = m.msg_version AND m.current_flag = 'Y'

models.name: session_tracker
models.query: SELECT s.session_id, s.user_id, s.session_start_time, s.session_end_time, s.device_type, s.browser, s.os_version, s.country, s.region, COUNT(e.event_id) as total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN substring_index(e.event_type, '.', 1) = 'Joinedmeeting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as join_count, SUM(CASE WHEN substring_index(e.event_type, '.', 1) = 'LeftMeeting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as left_count, SUM(CASE WHEN substring_index(e.event_type, '.', 1) = 'ScreenShare' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as screenshare_count, MIN(e.event_ts) as first_event_time, MAX(e.event_ts) as last_event_time, ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(e.event_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(e.event_ts))) / 60, 2) as session_duration_mins FROM session_raw s LEFT JOIN event_tracker e ON s.session_id = e.session_id GROUP BY s.session_id, s.user_id, s.session_start_time, s.session_end_time, s.device_type, s.browser, s.os_version, s.country, s.region

models.name: user_session_summary
models.query: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.country, u.region, COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) as total_sessions, SUM(s.total_events) as lifetime_events, SUM(s.join_count) as lifetime_joins, AVG(s.session_duration_mins) as avg_session_duration, MAX(s.last_event_ts) as last_activity_date FROM user_profile u LEFT JOIN session_tracker s ON u.user_id = s.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.country, u.region
